canonical_definition: A benchmark for evaluating multilingual cross-modal ambiguity resolution, consisting of 1278 samples in Chinese, English, and Malay, including dual-ambiguity cases where both text and image are ambiguous but jointly resolve to a single interpretation.
papers: MUCAR: Benchmarking Multilingual Cross-Modal Ambiguity Resolution for Multimodal Large Language Models

relationships.paper: MUCAR: Benchmarking Multilingual Cross-Modal Ambiguity Resolution for Multimodal Large Language Models
relationships.evidence: “MUCAR is the first benchmark to comprehensively address visual ambiguity, contextual ambiguity, and multilinguality, while integrating both human and GPT-based evaluation.”
